text:
mei: kicking off Harper LoRA graft bring-up (staged-graft with clamp) on int4 today. goal: quick compat + regression triage before canary. dropping a compact eval pack now (90 prompts: 40 convo, 30 instr, 20 edge-numeric).

akshay: nice. are we doing deterministic scoring or sampling?

mei: deterministic (temp=0). will also capture top-5 logits for ambiguous cases. runtime smoke only, not full A/B yet. infra: a10g-small, ctx=1024, batch=6.

ml-ci-bot: CI queued for 1760012345-harper-eval on infra: a10g-small. approx duration: 6m.

ops-bot: artifact prefix created: s3://redwood-evals/harper/har-graft-1760012345/ (permissions set to eng-ml + ops).

akshay: include fp16 + int8 baselines in the same folder so we can compute relative token-perf numbers.

mei: will run baselines then graft. uploading run script now.

ml-ci-bot: run started. model init OK. kv-cache prewarm success.

mei: quick log note: `INFO: stitch clamp applied at alpha=0.6` — we're intentionally limiting adapter weight to reduce regressions.

akshay: early logs show weird split on currency tokens like "$1.5M" -> ["$","1",".5","M"] causing downstream numeric normalizer to misfire. different from comma-case earlier.

sophie: Ugh. That will break our ledger canonicalizer. Can you save 10 worst examples to artifacts and tag as tokenization-cases?

mei: saved at s3:///harper/.../examples/currency_split.txt. included original prompt, token sequence, model output.

ml-ci-bot: batch 7/15 complete. aggregating metrics.

akshay: preliminary numbers: fp16 avg_rt 11.9ms avgLL -1.88; int8 avg_rt 8.7ms avgLL -2.05; staged-graft-int4 avg_rt 5.9ms avgLL -2.28. intent F1 on intent-suite: fp16 0.963, int8 0.957, graft-int4 0.949.

mei: thanks. delta mostly in long-form instruction rewrites and some numeric normalization.

tanner: can we try two quick mitigations before canary: 1) pull tokenizer pre-normalizer to coalesce currency tokens, 2) reduce clamp alpha to 0.5 and re-run the 20 failing prompts?

sophie: add to ENG-ML-912 and tag docs for numeric caveat if we keep int4.

mei: added tasks to ENG-ML-912. kicking a focused rerun for the 20 failing prompts with clamp=0.5 and tokenizer coalesce preproc.

ml-ci-bot: rerun started (tag: focused-20).

ml-ci-bot: rerun finished. artifacts uploaded: focused_metrics.json, focused_examples/.

akshay: focused run looks better: graft-int4 w/ coalesce + alpha=0.5 cuts failure count from 9->3 on that set. latency unchanged. quality still slightly below int8 but in pilot tolerance.

sophie: plan proposal: 1) deploy canary (12h) on dedicated pool with customer traffic shim, 2) enable fallback route to int8 model for error rates >2% or p95 latency > 2x baseline, 3) ship note to Harper outlining tokenizer caveat and fallback behavior.

mei: agreed. I'll schedule canary window tonight. putting fallback config in feature-flag `harper.graft.fallback`.

ml-ci-bot: CI finished for initial run: exit_code 0, artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/harper/har-graft-1760012345/.

ops-bot: created canary cluster template for Harper pilot (dedicated-small, 2 nodes) and added rollback runbook in ENG-ML-912.

mei: thanks team. will post short summary and attach key diffs to the ticket. :thumbsup:
